name: panelshelf
description: Self-hosted comic/book release metadata browser and download manager

scripts.dev: pnpm run db:migrate && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green 'pnpm --filter @panelshelf/backend run dev' 'pnpm --filter @panelshelf/frontend run dev'
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @panelshelf/backend run build && pnpm --filter @panelshelf/frontend run build
